Flow.description: Real bug fix (found 2026-09-06 during RS-06 testing, ALF-RS-04): a standalone Trade-In created with only OwnerId set (the normal case for anyone creating one via the standard New button/API without knowing to also fill in the custom AF_InitiatingSalesRep__c field) left that field blank, which broke AF_FL_Appraisal_FollowUpEscalation with "Assigned To ID: owner cannot be blank" — that flow keys off AF_InitiatingSalesRep__c specifically (not OwnerId, since OwnerId gets reassigned to the AF_Q_UsedCarTeam queue mid-lifecycle) and had no fallback for it being genuinely empty. Before-save default: if AF_InitiatingSalesRep__c is blank on create, default it to OwnerId. Only ever fills a blank — never overwrites a value the creating process (e.g. AF_FL_Opp_CreateExploreSideProcesses) already set explicitly. Extended 2026-09-08 (user noticed there are TWO similarly-named fields on the Appraisal page layout - the standard Automotive Cloud "Initiated By" field, InitiatedById, polymorphic Account/Contact/User, and this custom "Initiating Sales Rep" field, AF_InitiatingSalesRep__c - and only the custom one was ever being populated by any automation, leaving InitiatedById confusingly blank next to it on every record. The BRD only ever refers to "the Sales Representative who initiated the request" with no separate initiating party, so InitiatedById now defaults to the same OwnerId value as a plain cosmetic fix - same blank-only guard, no new logic elsewhere depends on it.
Flow.label: Appraisal Default Initiating Rep
